hook.name: FlowState C1 Hook
hook.description: Buy-only custom-curve hook that fills swap orders from the FlowState marketplace (off-chain listings and pool deposits), priced via an external settlement contract plus a size-adjusted spread. Sell direction reverts. Each fill pays a protocol fee to a TokenJar; hookData is not read. LP additions are blocked except for a single dust beacon position per pool, seeded on first fill.
